title: journal-record
description: One line of the per-repo turn journal (~/.config/slot/journal/<repo>.jsonl): an append-only fact about the fleet. The journal is history, never consumed (the inbox is the mailbox). The `type` vocabulary is closed per version: turn-* records are reserved for writers that hold the document's turn section; pane dispatch writes task-dispatched (fire-and-forget delivery has no observable completion, so it must never open a turn).

ts.description: when the fact was recorded, epoch ms

slot.description: the slot label the fact is about

type.description: closed v1 vocabulary; extend by schema bump, never ad hoc
